before.label: today: manual
before.total: ≈ 10 h 20 min of staff time per questionnaire (220 questions)

steps.task: Log the request, get the file or portal access, confirm scope and due date with the customer
Clean up the spreadsheet or copy questions out of the portal; split sections by owner
Search the answer library and past questionnaires; copy and adapt the answers that match
Check the SOC 2 report, ISO 27001 Statement of Applicability, policies and trust centre
Draft answers to the questions no earlier answer covers
Answer the technical questions sent to infrastructure, AppSec and IT
Chase owners, merge their replies, fix contradictions between sections
Review answers that touch contracts, certifications or the roadmap
Write answers back into the customer's format, attach evidence under NDA, submit

after.label: agent workflow
after.total: ≈ 2 h 50 min of human time per questionnaire

steps.task: Parse the spreadsheet, Word file or portal export into questions with cell addresses and answer types
Tag each question by control domain and answer type; flag anything that touches a commitment
Search the approved answer library; reuse in-date, high-similarity matches verbatim
Search policies, audit reports and the trust centre for questions with no library candidate
Draft the rest from library candidates and evidence excerpts, with sources and a confidence score
Read the whole questionnaire for contradictions, overcommitments and certification scope
Approve every new, changed, low-confidence or commitment answer in their own domain
Sign off the whole questionnaire; nothing goes to the customer before this
Write answers into the original format, check the NDA before attaching reports, update the library
